summary: Iter-13 re-test of iter-12 fixes. ALL 11 backend tests now pass (was 8/9). Duplicate PUT /supplier/listings/{id} route removed — ListingPatch handler now sole owner, returns {ok:true, updated:[...]} and persists ALL extended toner fields (price, stock, warranty, compatible_models, oem_part_number, cartridge_weight, print_technology, brand, color, page_yield, image_urls, intercity_delivery_charge). GET /listings/{id}/public reflects updated values. PUT /supplier/papers/{id} now accepts thickness_microns=115.5 (float→int cast, status 200). Invalid toner_type='Junk' returns 400 with message naming Original/Compatible/Refilled. Frontend: sticky search on /printers works (data-testid='printers-sticky-search/-input/-btn' present, submits to /printers/results?q=...). Supplier dashboard Edit pencil: edit-{id}, edit-printer-{id}, edit-paper-{id} buttons all present. Paper Edit dialog visually confirmed open with prefilled values (JK Paper, A4, 80 GSM, 10 reams, ₹320, stock 40, brightness 96, thickness 110, acid-free). All iter-12 critical & minor bugs are RESOLVED.

minor.issue: Field 'color' still only accepts {color, bw, both}; server validation works but the spec/docs should explicitly list allowed values. Carried over from iter-12, non-blocking.

integration_issues.flow: Supplier dashboard Toner / Printer Edit dialog visual confirmation
integration_issues.issue: Edit buttons (edit-{id}, edit-printer-{id}) are present and clickable, but in the headless run only the Paper edit dialog rendered visibly in the screenshot capture (toner & printer screenshots showed dashboard without overlay). The same Dialog component renders correctly for Paper, and the underlying state update logic for toner/printer is identical, so this is likely a Playwright timing / cookie-banner overlay quirk rather than a real bug. Backend round-trip (PUT + GET) for both toner and printer is verified passing 11/11. Recommend a manual click-through to visually confirm the toner & printer Edit dialogs open with prefilled brand/model/price/stock/intercity_delivery_charge.

action_items: Manually click Edit pencil on a toner and printer card in the supplier dashboard once to visually confirm the dialog opens with prefilled values (Paper already confirmed). All backend behavior is already passing.
(Non-blocking) Document allowed values for printer 'color' field (color/bw/both) in API docs.
critical_code_review_comments: Recommend adding a CI route-uniqueness check (e.g. tools/check_duplicate_routes.py) to prevent regression of the duplicate-route bug fixed in this iteration.
server.py is 3432 lines — consider splitting into routers (supplier_router.py, orders_router.py, admin_router.py) for maintainability.
POST /orders has no server-side validation for pincode/state values — consider 6-digit pincode regex and non-empty street/city/state checks.

rca of the issue: Iter-12 root cause was duplicate FastAPI route registration at server.py:909 shadowing the new ListingPatch handler at server.py:2828. Fix applied: line 909 changed from @api.put to @api.delete (the route at 909 is now the delete handler only). The PUT route is owned exclusively by supplier_patch_listing (line 2814) which uses ListingPatch model with all extended fields and graceful per-field column-missing fallback. Additional fix in PUT /supplier/papers/{id}: thickness_microns is now cast via int(round(float(...))) at line 2949, allowing the frontend to send fractional micron values (Pydantic model is Optional[float], DB column is INTEGER).
